title: Tactical Breach
game_overview: Engage tactical targets inside a dark concrete warehouse. Master weapon recoil and precision aim in this tense first-person shooter.
winning_condition: Neutralize all tactical training targets with accurate shots to clear the warehouse sector.
losing_condition: Run out of reserve ammunition before neutralizing all active tactical targets in the zone.

controls.input: Left Mouse Click / Tap Fire / Gamepad RT or A
controls.action: Fire weapon, triggering muzzle flash, recoil impulse, and raycast hit detection.

controls.input: Mouse Movement / Touch Drag Look / Gamepad Right Stick
controls.action: First-person camera look and targeting orientation.

controls.input: W/A/S/D / Virtual D-Pad / Gamepad Left Stick
controls.action: Move operative forward, left, backward, and right through the facility.

controls.input: R Key / Reload Button / Gamepad X
controls.action: Reload weapon magazine when ammunition is depleted.

sections.title: User Interface & Experience
sections.content: Updated the debug HUD overlay in App.tsx so the game launches cleanly with pure AAA tactical UI/HUD with showDebugPanel defaulted to false. A global keydown listener allows toggling the Technical Art Debug & Performance Profiler anytime using F3 or backtick (`). Styled in matching tactical black (rgba(10, 12, 14, 0.95)) and 1px borders with JetBrains Mono tabular telemetry, displaying live soldier and asset loading statuses, mesh/bone metrics, world positioning, active animation state, and interactive animation switchers. Added a subtle [F3] TA DEBUGGER hint in the bottom-right corner of the Start screen.
sections.summary: Clean launch UI with toggleable Technical Art Debugger & Profiler (F3 / `).
